job_title: Receptionist / Lễ Tân Giao Tiếp Tiếng Anh
technical_skills: Sử Dụng Phần Mềm Máy Tính (word, Excel)
working_hours: * 8h đến 17h từ thứ 2 đến thứ 6, thứ 7 đến 12h
benefits: Anual leave for employee every year.
bonus if the performance is good.
commission follow the policy of the company.
description:
• Create a positive and welcoming environment for all members
• Ensure the safety and security of the office and the co-working communities
• Assist & support C-level executive and managers in overseeing the day-to-day
• Assist with move-in and move-out procedures
• Ensure front desk, lobby & public areas are tidy and presentable
• Manage visitor log and generation of badges
• Answer the phone
• Check, sort and forward emails & phone calls
• Monitor office supplies and place orders when necessary
• Monitor office expenses
• Schedule meetings and manage conference rooms
• Schedule appointments for all services in the Business Center
requirements_text:
• Thoughtful listener who responds to the needs of others
• Strong communication skills in both Vietnamese and English
• A helpful, service-oriented, friendly, welcoming attitude
• Basic admin skills
• Experienced in related field
• Can work in international environment
• Can use the proficient of MS tools (Power Point, Excel & Word)
• Know how to listen and work in a team
Kỹ năng cần có
Làm việc nhóm, Chăm Sóc Khách Hàng, Giao tiếp tốt, Sử Dụng Phần Mềm Máy Tính (word, Excel)
Kỹ năng nên có
Tiếng Anh giao tiếp, Kiến Thức Về Hành Chính Văn Phòng
